extracted.intended_audience: USPTO stakeholders, patent practitioners, policymakers, and researchers analyzing patent and patent-office performance statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Extract and define the metrics, categories, and data definitions used in the USPTO Performance and Accountability Report (patent filing, pendency, issuance, reexamination and related administrative categories). Useful for interpreting or producing comparable patent-statistics reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serialized
rubrics_metrics.description: A newly filed UPR application that has been assigned a serial number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in tables for counts of 'Serialized' filings. Note: Serialized may include serialized plant and serialized reissues (see footnote: 'Serialized – includes serialized plant and serialized reissues'). Effective FY 2019, RCE and Serialized filings were reported separately; prior to FY 2019 they were combined.

rubrics_metrics.name: RCE (Request for Continued Examination)
rubrics_metrics.description: A procedure by which, after the prosecution has been closed by a final rejection, a notice of allowance, etc., the applicant pays a fee and requests that the prosecution of the application be reopened.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RCE totals include reissue RCEs (including plant RCEs). Effective FY 2019, RCE and Serialized filings were reported separately. Appears as a distinct filing category in multiple tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: CPA (Continued Prosecution Application)
rubrics_metrics.description: In a design application, a procedure by which the applicant, instead of filing a separate continuation or separate divisional application, renews the prosecution of his/her prior design application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as a filing type in filings-by-type tables (design applications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisional applications provided for in Public Law No. 103-465.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a category in filing statistics (footnote reference). No further procedural detail provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eighteen-month publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Eighteen-month publication of patent applications provided for the American Inventors Protection Act of 1999, Public Law No. 106-113.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnote defining publication timing; used as context for application/publication counts or timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average time between filing and issuance or abandonment
rubrics_metrics.description: Average time (in months) between filing and issuance or abandonment of utility, plant, and reissue applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This average does not include design patents. Appears as a summary metric of lifecycle length for applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Includes patent applications pending at end of period
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes patent applications pending at end of period indicated, and includes utility, reissue, plant, and design applications. Does not include allowed applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies scope of 'Total Applications Pending' in pendency tables; used to interpret pending counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications under examination, including those in preexamination processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to define the 'Applications under examination' portion of pending application totals; distinguishes from preexamination and postexamination processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awaiting Action by Examiner
rubrics_metrics.description: A classification for pending applications that are awaiting examiner action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears as a component of pending application counts ('Awaiting Action by Examiner'). Footnote indicates FY 2020 numbers updated with final end-of-year numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average First Action Pendency
rubrics_metrics.description: Average months to first action by an examiner for applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by Technology Center (e.g., Tech Center 1600, 1700, etc.) alongside Total Average Pendency to show speed of initial examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Average Pendency
rubrics_metrics.description: Average months from filing to issuance or abandonment (total pendency) for utility, plant, and reissue applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported by Technology Center and used to assess overall examination duration. Distinct from First Action Pendency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage of Processing — In Preexamination Processing, Total
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of applications that are in preexamination processing at the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the 'Stage of Processing' categories in Table 5 used to partition pending applications. Preexamination processing precedes substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage of Processing — Under Examination, Total
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of applications currently under substantive examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes dockets of cases actively being examined; a principal component of pending application totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage of Processing — Undocketed
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications that are under examination but not yet docketed for examiner action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subcategory used in processing-stage breakdowns; helps identify backlog before examiner assignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage of Processing — Awaiting First Action by Examiner
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications that are under examination but awaiting the examiner's first action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compute first-action pendency and to show pipeline status prior to substantive office actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage of Processing — Request for Continued Examination Awaiting First Action
rubrics_metrics.description: RCE filings that are awaiting an examiner's first action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separately counted to reflect RCE workload; appears as an item under pending application breakdowns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage of Processing — Rejected, Awaiting Response by Applicant
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications that have been rejected and are awaiting a response from the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the under-examination pipeline; indicates active prosecution status pending applicant reply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage of Processing — Amended, Awaiting Action by Examiner
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications amended by applicants and awaiting examiner review/action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reflects pendency caused by applicant amendments; appears in stage breakdowns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage of Processing — In Interference
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications currently involved in interference proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special proceeding count included in pending/application stage breakdowns (interference numbers are typically small or zero).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage of Processing — On Appeal, and Other
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications that are on appeal or in other special categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Footnote: 'Includes cases on appeal and undergoing petitions.' Used in pending totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage of Processing — In Postexamination Processing / Awaiting Issue Fee / Awaiting Printing / D-10s
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of applications in postexamination steps: awaiting issue fee, awaiting printing, and D-10s (Secret Cases in Condition for Allowance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to show cases that have completed examination but await administrative finalization. D-10s are applications classified under U.S.C. § 181 that are otherwise in condition for allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Applications Filed by Type (Utility, Design, Plant, Reissue, Total)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of applications filed by type: Utility, Serialized (UPR), RCE, Design, CPA, Plant, Reissue, and Total.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables present year-by-year filing totals by type; footnotes clarify inclusion rules and that utility category includes chemical, electrical, and mechanical applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patents Issued by Type (Utility, Design, Plant, Reissue, Total)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of patents issued by type—Utility, Design, Plant, Reissue—and Total issued patents for each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to track grant volumes annually. Footnotes note that past years' data may have been revised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications/Patents by Residence (U.S. Residents; Foreign Residents; State/Territory/Country breakdowns)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of patent applications filed and patents issued broken out by residence of filer/inventor (states, territories, countries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple tables present FY-by-FY breakdowns by U.S. state/territory and by foreign country; footnotes note country listing conventions and that 'Patent origin is based on residence of the first-named inventor.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of Utility Patents Issued to Micro, Small, and Large Entities
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage breakdown of utility patents issued categorized by micro, small, and large entities, with separate columns for U.S. origin and foreign origin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables report percentages by year. Footnote clarifies 'Patent origin is based on residence of the first-named inventor.' Data for FY 2021 filing are preliminary.

rubrics_metrics.name: United States Government Agency Patents (by agency/department)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of utility patents assigned to U.S. government agencies or departments at time of patent issue (e.g., Agriculture, Commerce, Defense subcomponents, Energy, HHS, NASA, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to report patenting activity originating within government agencies. Footnotes: Data represent patents assigned to agencies at issue and are subject to revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ex Parte Reexamination metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Metrics for ex parte reexamination: Requests Filed (Total), By Patent Owner, By Third Party, Commissioner Ordered; Determinations on Requests (Total), Requests Granted (By Examiner, By Petition), Requests Denied, Requests Known to Have Related Litigation; Filings by Discipline (Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, Design).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table 13A provides year-by-year counts. Notes: Only represents requests that have received a filing date. Litigation search numbers were updated to include old pending reexaminations that ultimately require new litigation. Filings updated to include reexams without a filing date or vacated filing dates in FY20.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental Examination metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Metrics for supplemental examinations: Supplemental Examinations Filed (Total), Supplemental Examinations Granted a Filing Date (Total), Determinations on Supplemental Examinations Granted a Filing Date (Total), Substantial New Question Found, Substantial New Question Not Found, Requests Known to Have Related Litigation, Filings by Discipline (Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, Design).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table 13B presents year-by-year counts. Footnotes indicate updates and clarifications similar to reexamination tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Represents zero / N/A / Data revision notes
rubrics_metrics.description: '- Represents zero.' and 'N/A' markers and footnotes indicating that past years’ data may have been revised from prior-year reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard table notation: '-' means zero. Several footnotes repeatedly advise that FY 2021 filing data are preliminary and will be finalized in the next PAR, and that past years' data may have been revised.
